meta.name: hypothesis-generation
meta.description: Structured hypothesis formulation from observations. Use when you have experimental observations or data and need to formulate testable hypotheses with predictions, propose mechanisms, and design experiments to test them. Follows scientific method framework. For open-ended ideation use scientific-brainstorming; for automated LLM-driven hypothesis testing on datasets use hypogenic.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将观察转化为可检验的假设与实验方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你有实验数据或观察结果，需要系统性地提出科学假设并设计验证实验。
copy.tagline_en: Turn observations into testable hypotheses and experiments

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会根据你的观察或数据，系统性地生成可检验的科学假设，包括提出机制、设计实验和预测结果，并输出带示意图的 LaTeX 报告。
howto.when: 当你提供实验观察、数据或科学问题，需要形成可检验的假设时触发。

say.text: 根据这些细胞实验数据，生成三个竞争性假设。
say.note: Claude 会搜索文献、提出假设并设计实验。

say.text: 帮我设计一个实验来检验这个假设。
say.note: Claude 会给出具体的实验方案和预测。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude systematically generates testable scientific hypotheses from your observations or data, including proposing mechanisms, designing experiments, and formulating predictions, outputting a LaTeX report with diagrams.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide experimental observations, data, or scientific questions that require testable hypotheses.

say_en.text: Based on these cell experiment data, generate three competing hypotheses.
say_en.note: Claude will search literature, propose hypotheses, and design experiments.

say_en.text: Design an experiment to test this hypothesis.
say_en.note: Claude will provide a specific experimental plan and predictions.
